title: Past and storytelling
function: Tell what you did yesterday or last weekend

sections.heading: What is the Past Simple?
sections.body: The Past Simple is used to talk about finished actions in the past. It is very common when telling stories, talking about holidays or describing what happened yesterday.

sections.heading: Regular verbs
sections.body: Regular verbs add -ed in the past.

sections.heading: Irregular verbs
sections.body: Irregular verbs do not follow the -ed rule. You have to learn them.
table: I went to Italy last summer.
We took a lot of photos.

sections.heading: Negative
list: I did not go to school yesterday.
She did not like the film.
They did not come to the party.

sections.heading: Questions
list: Did you watch the match?
Did she visit her grandmother?
Where did they go last weekend?

sections.heading: Time expressions
list: yesterday, last night, last week, last year
two days ago, a month ago
in 2020, in summer
when I was young

sections.heading: Common mistakes
list: Do not use 'did' with past simple: 'I did went' is wrong. Say 'I went'.
Do not use the base form after 'did': 'Did you went?' is wrong. Say 'Did you go?'.
Learn the irregular verbs by heart.

list.definition: We went to the beach every day.
I swam in the sea in July.
She visited a museum in Paris.
I took many photos on holiday.
We went sightseeing in Rome.
They ate in a nice restaurant.
I bought some souvenirs for my family.
We met new people at the hotel.
We went for a walk in the park.
I relaxed on the beach all day.
We travelled by car to France.
They went by train to London.
I flew by plane to Greece.
We went by bus to the city centre.
They crossed the river by boat.
We went on foot to the market.
It was sunny every day.
It was rainy on Monday.
The sky was cloudy.
It was windy at the beach.
It was very hot in summer.
It was cold in the morning.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.intro: Look at these sentences. Read them carefully and think about the questions below.
sentences: Last summer we went to Italy.
They did not come to the party.
We took a lot of photos.
questions: In sentences 1 and 6, what ending do regular verbs have?
In sentences 2, 3 and 7, do the verbs follow the -ed rule? Why not?
In sentence 4, how do we make the negative?
In sentence 5, how do we make a question?
In sentence 8, what is the past form of 'take'?

questions.prompt: Last weekend we ___ to the beach.
questions.explanation: Go is irregular. Its Past Simple is 'went'.

questions.prompt: They ___ not come to the party.
questions.explanation: Past negative: did not + base verb.
Past question: Did + subject + base verb.

questions.prompt: We ___ a lot of photos on holiday.
He ___ pizza for dinner last night.

questions.explanation: Past of 'to be' with singular: was.

phases.name: Free practice
prompts: Write 5 sentences about what you did last weekend. Use the Past Simple.
Write a short paragraph (6-8 sentences) about your last holiday. Include where you went, how you travelled, what you did and the weather.
Write 3 things you did yesterday and 3 things you did not do.

questions.prompt: I ___ to the cinema last night.
She ___ a new dress for the party.
He ___ a letter to his friend.
The children ___ in the park all afternoon.
They ___ a delicious meal at the restaurant.

questions.explanation: Past question: did + subject + base verb.

sections.heading: Key rules
list: Regular verbs: add -ed (played, watched, studied).
Irregular verbs: change completely (go → went, see → saw, eat → ate).
Negative: did not + base verb.
Questions: Did + subject + base verb?
Time expressions: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020.

sections.heading: Common mistakes
list: Do not mix 'did' with past: 'I did went' is wrong.
Do not use base form after 'did' in questions: 'Did you went?' is wrong.
Learn the most common irregular verbs by heart.

sections.heading: Useful phrases
list: Yesterday I...
Last weekend we...
Two days ago she...
Did you...?
I did not...
It was... (weather)
